## Details

<a id="circle_radius"></a>
### [`circle_radius`](../../../../src/graphics/circle.asm#L6) `$3B41`

*routine*

Swaps the two shape points, so that the centre is the second point. The radius is |dx| + |dy| of the points, at most max_y. Sets point_x0 and line_dx to the radius.

- **Called from:** [`circle_xor`](circle.md#circle_xor)
- **Reads:** [`shape_y1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y1), [`shape_y0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y0), [`shape_x1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x1), [`shape_x0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x0), [`temp_word`](../../memory-map.md#temp_word), [`max_y`](../../memory-map.md#max_y)
- **Writes:** [`shape_y0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y0), [`shape_y1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y1), [`shape_x0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x0), [`shape_x1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x1), [`temp_word`](../../memory-map.md#temp_word), [`point_x0`](../../memory-map.md#point_x0), [`line_dx`](../../memory-map.md#line_dx), [`line_x_negative`](../../memory-map.md#line_x_negative), [`line_dy`](../../memory-map.md#line_dy), [`line_y_negative`](../../memory-map.md#line_y_negative)

<a id="circle_xor"></a>
### [`circle_xor`](../../../../src/graphics/circle.asm#L51) `$3B85`

*routine*

Draws the circle of shape_x0/y0 and shape_x1/y1 with the XOR plot ($18c2): the rubber circle of the Circle and Disc tools. Keeps the shape points and the circle points ($3e-$41).
circle_step_vector = $3d49: plots 4 points at each step.

<a id="circle_run"></a>
### [`circle_run`](../../../../src/graphics/circle.asm#L124) `$3BF6`

*routine*

Steps through a quarter of the circle with the midpoint method: circle_dy starts at the radius, circle_dx at 0, the error (point_x1/point_y1) at 2 - 2 * radius. It calls the routine of circle_step_vector for each point. That routine ends the loop when circle_dy is 0.

- **Called from:** [`circle_xor`](circle.md#circle_xor)
- **Calls:** [`circle_plot`](circle.md#circle_plot), [`circle_double_error`](circle.md#circle_double_error), [`circle_dec_work`](circle.md#circle_dec_work), [`circle_add_x_to_error`](circle_plot_3d3c.md#circle_add_x_to_error), [`circle_inc_error`](circle_plot_3d3c.md#circle_inc_error), [`circle_sub_y_from_error`](circle_plot_3d3c.md#circle_sub_y_from_error)
